result.title: RECAST: REconstruction of Chain-of-Thought via Auditable Structured Traces
result.summary: Large closed-source reasoning models expose only their final answers. The intermediate reasoning that produces those answers is hidden behind API surfaces, tool-call policies, and safety filters. Existing chain-of-thought (CoT) extraction methods assume a side channel: a visible reasoning field, a scratchpad carried through tool calls, or a signed/encrypted reasoning block. We reproduce three representative state-of-the-art extraction methods and find that, on Claude-Sonnet-5.5 accessed through the standard chat-completions interface, all three return zero CoT tokens. The failure is structural rather than a bug: the reasoning field is absent, named tool selection is rejected, free-text scratchpad arguments are filtered, and no replayable reasoning block is exposed. We therefore take a different route. We present RECAST, a reconstruction-based framework that conditions a decoder on the question and the target model's final answer, reconstructs a first-person structured rationale, cleans it, and builds SFT-ready data. To the best of our knowledge, RECAST is the first system to reconstruct CoT from frontier closed models such as Claude-Sonnet-5.5, GPT-6.1, and Gemini 3 without using hidden reasoning channels. We instantiate RECAST on Claude-Sonnet-5.5 and additionally obtain successful qualitative reconstructions on GPT-6.1 and Gemini 3 with the same answer-only protocol. The system is open-source and packaged as an agent skill: one prompt deploys it and runs the complete pipeline to produce SFT-ready CoT data. This preprint describes the system, its threat model, and a controlled artifact validation; it does not claim large-scale benchmark improvements.

AI.brief_summary: 论文先复现三种 CoT 抽取方法，发现它们在闭源前沿模型的常规接口上因推理字段缺失、工具参数被过滤而全部失效，转而提出 RECAST：以问题与目标模型最终答案为条件，让解码器重建第一人称结构化推理链，清洗后构建可供 SFT 的数据，并在 Claude-Sonnet-5.5 上实例化、在另两个模型上做定性尝试。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关联，但其「仅有答案即可重建推理轨迹并转成监督数据」的流程，可能为 LVR 在缺少 latent 状态标注时的轨迹监督与贡献分配提供可核查线索；重建轨迹是否忠实反映真实计算并未验证。
